exposure: Travel time from health center to district hospital
Time from decision for emergency cesarean section to surgical incision
Time from admission to surgical incision
Time from decision for cesarean section to surgical incision
Duration of labor prior to hospital admission
outcome: Neonatal outcome (APGAR score < 7 at 5 minutes or death vs. alive and APGAR score ≥ 7 at 5 minutes)
cohort: 441 neonates and their mothers who underwent emergency cesarean section in 2015 at three district hospitals in Rwanda.
finding: Longer travel time between the health center and the district hospital was associated with an increased risk of unfavorable neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Neonates whose cesarean deliveries started more than 30 minutes after the decision for cesarean section had better outcomes than those starting immediately.
